messages:
maya: quick flag  monitoring picked up a subtle increase in 99th for model redwood-llama3q on runtime 3.2.0 in ap-southeast around 02:10 UTC.
sre-oncall: saw that. error rate stable but tail latency creeping up. any recent rollout overlap? :thinking_face:
fergie: runtime 3.2.0 rolled to canaries yesterday, full rollout 01:45 UTC. metric anomaly aligns with rollout.
deploybot: Deploybot: Compatibility advisory \u2014 model:redwood-llama3q vs runtime:3.2.0. Recommended temporary mitigation: regional pin to runtime 3.1.4 or route heavy longseq customers to dedicated capacity. Commands: `/deploy pin --model redwood-llama3q --runtime 3.1.4 --region ap-southeast --duration 24h --reason "99th-latency-regression"`
maya: prefer regional pin + phased unpin rather than global rollback. also want a phased-unpin plan (1%,5%,20%,50%,100%) with canary watch at each step for 15m.
tom: agree. i'll create the phased-unpin job and a guardrail that aborts and re-pins if 99th > baseline * 1.25 for 15m.
fergie: please also capture traces for long-lived requests (seq > 2048). might be a KV-cache path regression.
sre-oncall: on it. enabling extra debug traces for affected backends (sampling 1%). will redact PII.
deploybot: Deploybot: Pin executed (task id 992001). Safelist routing applied: existing customers with <3qps directed to 3.1.4. Phased-unpin job created (job id pu-992001) steps: 1%->5%->20%->50%->100% with 15m hold per step. Abort condition: 99th >= 1.25x baseline or errors >= 1.5x.
maya: added to release-notes draft: "ap-southeast: temporary regional pin of redwood-llama3q to runtime 3.1.4 due to 99th latency regression; phased unpin planned pending telemetry." 
fergie: QA, please run longseq smoke with user-sim prompts + KV stress. tagging @qa. give thumbs up when green.
qa-bot: QA-bot: queued regression job rq-5678 for longseq-KV-sanity, ETA 18m.
tom: also creating quick rollback playbook snippet and a `deploy-alert` hook to page #oncall if abort triggers.
sre-oncall: early telemetry after pin: pinned cohort 99th improved from 880ms -> 420ms, region overall improved ~8%. keeping watch for error deltas.
maya: excellent. if stable for 90m we start phased-unpin tomorrow 03:00 local with 2h observation window. otherwise extend pin.
fergie: added automated note in runbook: `if abort -> contact eng-releases + eng-runtime and keep pin for min 12h`.
maya: closing coordination thread; keep logs here. ping if abort happens or publish final unpin timeline. :white_check_mark:
